title: Mount St Helens observers killed by heat miles away

tellings.quote: watch documentaries on Mount St Helens right when it erupted people were 5 10 miles away observing it

plain: When Mount St Helens erupted in Washington state in 1980, people watching from five or ten miles away were killed by the heat, says Matt LaCroix, a researcher of ancient history, pointing Michels to documentaries about the eruption. He brings it up in a conversation about a catastrophe he places around 12,000 BC, to show how far a natural disaster's deadly reach can stretch.
